overview: TradeNest Naturals is an FSSAI-licensed manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter delivering premium dried hibiscus flower powder directly from India. Produced from carefully selected petals, our powder retains its characteristic tart flavor and deep crimson profile. We maintain total production oversight, offering consistent bulk botanical raw materials that integrate smoothly into modern industrial processing lines worldwide.

Our production follows a dedicated six-step method encompassing disciplined sourcing, cleaning, controlled dehydration, milling to 80-100 mesh, inspection, and dispatch. Containing no synthetic colors or additives, this free-flowing botanical ingredient serves beverage, food, and cosmetic formulations. We provide global buyers with adaptable batch capacities, private-label packaging options, and full export documentation support.
highlights: Uniform fine grind rated at 80 to 100 mesh
Moisture content rigorously controlled at 8% or below
Deep natural crimson color with tart flavor profile
Free-flowing powder free from synthetic colors and additives
Stable shelf life of 24 months under recommended storage
Traceable Indian origin processed under a 6-step workflow
applications: Herbal tea blends and infusion mixes
Fruit jams, preserves, and fruit spreads
Hair care and scalp treatment preparations
Dry blending and powdered drink mixes
packaging: 25 kg bulk export bags and HDPE containers
5 kg to 10 kg multi-ply moisture-barrier bags
Custom small private-label jars and canisters

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for hibiscus flower powder?
faqs.a: Our standard minimum order quantity is 5 kg, catering to formulation trials, emerging consumer brands, and large-scale bulk procurement.

faqs.q: Can you provide custom mesh sizes and packaging options?
faqs.a: Yes. We offer custom grinding specifications beyond our standard 80-100 mesh along with specialized private-label packaging formats upon request.

faqs.q: Are commercial product samples available for laboratory testing?
faqs.a: We provide pre-shipment product samples on request to assist formulators and manufacturers with analytical evaluation and recipe development.

faqs.q: What are the recommended storage requirements for this product?
faqs.a: Store in sealed original packaging within a cool, dry area away from direct sunlight and ambient moisture to maintain stability for up to 24 months.

faqs.q: Do you offer private label and OEM manufacturing services?
faqs.a: Yes. As an FSSAI-licensed manufacturer, we manage contract packaging, OEM processing, and custom labeling across pouches, jars, and bulk cartons.

faqs.q: What documentation is provided for international consignments?
faqs.a: As an IEC-registered exporter, we provide comprehensive export documentation support to streamline customs clearance and commercial logistics for overseas buyers.
